difficulty: One-page invoice: letterhead, boxed key/value panel, zebra grid line-item table with merged total rows, borderless bank table, typed dash list.
title: Invoice 2026-0417
key_sentences: All goods were delivered to your yard at Dunmore on 5 March 2026.
Payment is due within 30 days of the invoice date.
Please quote the invoice number as the payment reference.
We thank you for your order and look forward to supplying you again.

list_items.text: – Goods remain the property of Harbourline Marine Supplies Ltd until paid in full.
– Late payments carry interest at 4 % above the Bank of England base rate.
– Damaged or missing items must be reported within 7 days of delivery.

furniture: Registered in England and Wales, company no. 00000000
notes: Letterhead lines (organisation, address, contact) are furniture, not headings. The "Invoice 2026-0417" heading is the title. Table 1 is a boxed 4-column key/value panel with no header row (head row = first row). Table 2 is the line-item table; the three total rows use a label cell spanning the first four columns, so the label is repeated in all four grid cells. Table 3 is a borderless 2-column key/value table (bank details). The three list items are typed en-dashes at level 0 (marker "–" is part of the text). The footer has two lines; page number is typed "Page 1 of 1".
